collection.catalogue: full actual descriptor and exact model/hash; preserve positional parameter order
collection.journal: descriptor then20literal requests; original17nondefault cases unchanged; default uses complete declared10kPa example; original100kPa failure and same-instance recovery are separately named.
collection.json: reject duplicate keys and nonfinite numbers; exact Boolean status
collection.instance: one persistent Wasm module with baseline/failure/recovery order; fresh native command per call
collection.retention: Reuse exact native/Wasm artifacts from source-identical frozen v1 runtime after hash verification; no new build. Freeze v2 consumer/request/policy/assessment and original artifact/build/source receipt identities before observations.

success_gates.points: steps+1, initial row exact requested state and zero strain/control
success_gates.finite_shapes: state7,strain6,p,q,q_signed,u,control; all finite real numbers, bool forbidden
success_gates.state_domain: e>=0,p>0; independent Cartesian stress principal minors positive; no near-boundary precision theorem
success_gates.loading_curve: target*i/steps for monotonic; target*sin(2*pi*cycles*i/steps) for cyclic; absolute tolerance1e-12*max(1,abs(target))
success_gates.stress_observable_reconstruction: p,q,q_signed,u recomputed independently from returned Cartesian stress; scaled absolute discrepancy<=1e-10*max(1,abs(expected))
success_gates.recovery: successful physical channels bitwise identical to same_result_as in same backend; exclude wall time and diagnostic work counters
success_gates.settings: exact returned six settings/version/norm plus echoed model/parameters/initial/request controls and catalogue hash
success_gates.axisymmetry: abs(strain_yy-strain_zz)<=1e-7 and abs(each Mandel shear strain)<=1e-7

failure_gates.negative_density_integrate: all7 returned state bits equal supplied invalid incoming state
failure_gates.recovery: subsequent valid calls must match pre-failure baseline
failure_gates.legacy-100kPa-drained-incompatible: exact step1 failure message, one bitwise-identical initial point, zero control/strain, exact echoed request/settings/model/catalogue; original v1 prospective success gate remains failed unchanged.

parity.channels: all successful state/strain/p/q/q_signed/u/control; zero/rollback and recovery have separate exact checks

browser.consumer: select candidate and Load model example use actual declared10kPa and illustrative default parameters with1%drained100increments; no native model-ID branch or constitutive changes
browser.export: actual settings-aware browser exported specification equals frozen consumer-default request, successful101points; all physical channels match frozen Wasm within original scaled1e-10parity budget; independent void/control checks unchanged
browser.rights_and_preparation: software example only; no specimen preparation/calibration or experimental validation
browser.scope: local isolated candidate site; root installation conditional on passing gates
